store.summary: Four-track groovebox: drum machine, JUNO/DX7 synths, sampler, sequencer and tape arrangement.
store.description: Cardenza Synth is a self-contained four-track groovebox for the CardputerZero. Each track runs an 808-style drum machine, a JUNO or DX7 style synth voice, or a sampler, all driven by a step sequencer and arranged on a tape-style song view. A hands-on 320x170 interface keeps the drum pads, instrument pages, per-track steps and a colour-coded scene navigator one keystroke away.

zh-CN.summary: 四轨 Groovebox 合成器：808 鼓机、JUNO/DX7 合成器、采样器、步进音序与磁带编曲。
zh-CN.description: Cardenza Synth 是 CardputerZero 上的四轨 Groovebox。每条轨可跑 808 风格鼓机、JUNO 或 DX7 风格合成器音色，或采样器，由步进音序器驱动、在磁带式编曲视图里成曲。320×170 的双手界面一键切换鼓垫、乐器参数、逐轨步进和彩色场景导航。
